# ScrollArea

A scrollable region with consistent scrollbar treatment across platforms.

- **Import:** `import { ScrollArea } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-scrollarea--docs>

## Example

From its `HorizontalQuickAccess` story.

```tsx
import { Card, ScrollArea, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ScrollAreaExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-[360px] border rounded-container bg-card overflow-hidden">
        <ScrollArea orientation="horizontal" snap="x" className="p-4 w-full">
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
              <div key={i} className="snap-start shrink-0">
                <Card className="w-[200px] h-[120px] flex items-center justify-center bg-muted">
                  Item {i}
                </Card>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## ScrollArea

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `ScrollAreaProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `orientation`: `"vertical" | "horizontal" | "both"`, optional, default `"vertical"`.
- `hideScrollbar`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
- `snap`: `"none" | "x" | "y" | "both"`, optional, default `"none"`.
- `viewportProps`: `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`, optional.

  Attributes for the scrollable, keyboard-focusable viewport. The ref remains on the outer wrapper.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
